tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §2, Paul 2026-11-19). The page: the floor of every screen on both apps. Nothing a member reads or presses sits straight on it except a page title; content sits in a raised group one step up.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §2; phone step 2026-11-13). The raised step, 1.08:1 over background. Web: the sidebar, the page header, a field's fill. Phone: every raised group, card and state card, and the fill under the glass chrome.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §2). Web: a raised group or card on a surface-1 pane, and the Secondary button's fill. Phone: what needs its own edge inside a raised group (a lead tile, a chip, a field, a held row), and a group inside a sheet.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §2). The elevated step: menus, popovers, dialogs, the docked panel's header, a phone sheet's fill, a selected table row, a switch's off track.

tokens.name: card-hover
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §6, 2026-11-19). The one hover, pressed and keyboard-highlight fill, in menus, lists, tables and rails alike. It sits above the whole ladder so it reads even on popover. Never an accent tint. Not an elevation step.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The ShadCN pair of card; same value as foreground. Prefer foreground in new code.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The ShadCN pair of popover; same value as foreground. Prefer foreground in new code.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Confirmed (Paul 2026-11-20: "more hairlines. I cant tell surfaces apart"). The hairline: every pane edge, every raised group's edge, every divider between rows. About 1.65:1 over the page, so the line does the separating and the fills stay soft. A meaning-carrying control edge takes control-edge instead.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §3). The quiet edge for things meant to recede: wells, drop slots, a done or placeholder checkbox, a frame around a preview. Also the neutral chip's fill. Never the edge of a control a member has to find.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §3, #4389). The edge that identifies a control: text fields, select triggers, the Secondary and New buttons' neutral edge, segmented controls, a switch's off track on web. Clears 3:1 on every surface (measured 3.40 to 3.83).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §4). Primary text: titles, row titles, typed values, numbers and figures. On background, surface-1, card, popover and card-hover (18.11 / 16.81 / 15.28 / 13.33 / 11.58 :1).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §4). Secondary text: a row's meta line, section headers, icons that label a row. On every ladder step and card-hover (11.32 down to 7.24 :1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §4). Tertiary TEXT, not a fill: timestamps, placeholders, a read channel's name, the dot separators of a meta line. On every ladder step and card-hover (8.30 down to 5.31 :1).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §4). Disabled labels only. Deliberately under 4.5:1 (3.71 down to 2.37 :1; WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for text a member is meant to read: use muted.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Confirmed (accent-engine §2). The chapter accent's solid fill, shown here as the house default; every chapter overrides it at runtime. Only for the seven uses in the brand book's Accent section. As text or a glyph it reads on every ladder step (10.36 down to 6.62 :1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Confirmed (accent-engine §2). Hover of a primary fill. primary-foreground on it is 7.43:1.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed (accent-engine §8). Ink on a primary fill, 8.37:1. The engine contrast-gates this pair for every chapter seed.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §10). Focus ring colour: a 3px spread at 25% opacity, with the control's border switching to accent-text. One recipe on every control.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Confirmed (accent-engine §2). The accent's tint fill: the Tinted button, the active navigation row, a chat row that mentions you, a selected option. foreground on it is 12.84:1, accent-text 8.58:1.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Confirmed (accent-engine §2). The edge of an accent-tinted surface. Decorative only (1.64 to 2.57 :1 on the ladder), so it never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Confirmed (accent-engine §2). The accent as text: a link in running text, the label of a Tinted or outlined accent button, the border of a focused control. On every ladder step (12.10 down to 7.74 :1) and on accent-subtle (8.58:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5, lifted 2026-11-12). Status only: paid, confirmed, checked in, check-in is open. As a status word's text on background, surface-1, card and popover (8.64 / 8.02 / 7.29 / 6.36 :1). As a fill it takes success-foreground.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Ink on a solid success fill, 8.67:1. White there is 2.28:1.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5, #2376). The success chip's fill, with success as its text (5.06 to 7.24 :1 over the four ladder steps; 4.41 over card-hover, so a hovered row's chip is just under 4.5). Always this token, never an alpha utility.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). Status only: pending, at risk, due soon. As text on every ladder step (8.80 down to 6.48 :1).

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Ink on a solid warning fill, 8.82:1.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). The warning chip's fill, with warning as its text (5.11 to 7.33 :1 on the ladder).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5, lifted 2026-11-12). Fill and border of a destructive control, and an error icon. As text it holds on background to popover (6.87 down to 5.06 :1) but is 4.39 on card-hover: for text use destructive-text.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Ink on a solid destructive fill, 6.89:1.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). Danger as TEXT: Overdue, a form error, Delete in a menu, the label on a destructive tint. On every ladder step and card-hover (9.33 down to 5.96 :1), and on destructive-tint (5.01 to 8.06 :1).

tokens.name: destructive-tint
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). The fill of a destructive button and a danger chip. Its text is always destructive-text.

tokens.name: destructive-tint-hover
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). Hover of the destructive button's tint.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). Informational status as a fill, dot or border only. As text it is under 4.5:1 on card and popover (4.45 / 3.88), so text takes info-text.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Ink on a solid info fill, 5.28:1.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5, lifted 2026-11-12). Info as TEXT: In progress. On every ladder step and card-hover (7.97 down to 5.10 :1).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5, #4133). The info chip's fill, with info-text as its text (5.01 to 7.09 :1 on the ladder).

tokens.name: mention
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5). One fact only: you were addressed. The mention and direct-message count badge, and the dot on an avatar. Never the chapter accent, never another status, never text.

tokens.name: mention-foreground
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The count on a mention badge. Known miss, kept exact: white on mention is 3.91:1, under 4.5 (tracked in #1190).

tokens.name: mention-chip
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §5, 2026-11-06). Fill of the @Name chip inside a message body. Opaque, fixed, never the accent.

tokens.name: mention-chip-text
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The handle on mention-chip, 10.65:1.

tokens.name: gold-house
tokens.usage: Confirmed (brand-identity §2). Frapp's own gold, fixed for every chapter. Only where Frapp speaks as itself (Ask's source markers). Never inside a chapter's own chrome. Reads on every ladder step (10.74 down to 6.87 :1).

tokens.name: gold-on-house
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Ink on gold-house, 8.70:1.

tokens.name: gold-ask-fill
tokens.usage: Confirmed (2026-11-12). Tinted fill of Ask's source markers and chip numbers.

tokens.name: gold-ask-border
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Edge of an Ask source marker.

tokens.name: gold-ask-text
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Text on gold-ask-fill, 9.81:1.

tokens.name: hue-orange
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §6 A place’s hue, Paul 2026-11-12; ROLE_COLOR_PALETTE in packages/validation/src/role-colors.ts). Orange: the fixed hue of Directory, a role colour a chapter can pick, and an initials avatar. Painted as a tile: the hue at 14% over card with the glyph or initials in the hue at full strength. A hue names a place, a role or a person, never a state, and is never the chapter accent.

tokens.name: skeleton-highlight
tokens.usage: Confirmed (2026-11-19). The shimmer's midpoint, 1.19:1 over popover. Only the skeleton sweep uses it. Skeletons are never accent and never semantic.

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb
tokens.usage: Confirmed (Paul 2026-11-05). The scrollbar thumb at rest. Neutral, never the accent. A recorded contrast exception that no other control may cite.

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The thumb under the pointer.

tokens.name: scrollbar-track
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The track paints nothing, so the bar sits on whatever surface the region has.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7). The one big figure of a screen: a points total, a study timer, hours this term. With tabular numerals. At most one per screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7). A record's own title on its page: an event, a task, a set of minutes, a member's name on their profile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7). The page title in the page header, a dialog's or sheet's title, a create form's borderless title field.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring the signed forms to chapter on Sunday.
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7). Running text a member reads and anything a member types: a message, a description, minutes, a field's value. Never below 16.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7; patterns § Rows). A row's title, a button's label, a tab, a table header, a section header. For controls and rows, never paragraphs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7; patterns § Rows). A row's one meta line, a timestamp, a chip's word, a field's error line. Metadata only.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Confirmed (foundations §7). A join code, an invite token. A system stack, never a bundled font. It carries no size of its own: it takes the size of the role it sits in (shown here at label size). Money, points and timers are NOT mono: they are Figtree with tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §9). The grid unit. Between a glyph and its label; between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Inside a component: gaps between a row's lead, text and trailing; between buttons in a header.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Confirmed. A control's horizontal padding; a row's horizontal padding inside a raised group on web.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Between components; a raised group's inner gutter on the phone; the page gutter on the phone.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Between sections: one raised group and the next section header; the page gutter on web.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Confirmed. A major break inside a long page.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Page-level separation, and the height of web's page header.

tokens.name: control-chip
tokens.usage: Confirmed value (foundations §9 control size scale, Paul 2026-11-05); Proposed as a token. Height of a status chip, a count, a filter's removable chip. On touch the hit area is still 44 through padding or hitSlop.

tokens.name: control-row
tokens.usage: Confirmed value (foundations §9); Proposed as a token. Height of a menu row, a select row, a segmented control and a property row's value on a mouse. 44 on touch.

tokens.name: control-small
tokens.usage: Confirmed value (foundations §9); Proposed as a token. Header buttons (New, Filter, icon buttons), tabs, a table header, a dense list row. 44 on touch.

tokens.name: control-field
tokens.usage: Confirmed value (foundations §9); Proposed as a token. Text fields, select triggers, a dialog's buttons. 44 on touch.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §9). The floor for anything a finger lands on, on the phone and on web under a coarse pointer. A one-line phone row is 44 to 48; a two-line row grows from the same floor.

tokens.name: touch-button
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The standard button height on touch.

tokens.name: touch-button-large
tokens.usage: Confirmed (signet.ts touch.buttonLarge). Phone only: the full-width button that ends sign-in, setup and payment. Nowhere else since Paul's 2026-11-20 ruling against full-width buttons.

tokens.name: touch-tab-bar
tokens.usage: Confirmed (signet.ts touch.tabBar). Height of a tab item inside the phone's 62px floating glass tab bar.

tokens.name: scrollbar-width
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §12). The scrollbar gutter; the visible thumb is 4px after its 1px inset.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §8). Chips, badges, a checkbox, a small lead tile.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Confirmed. A navigation row, a large chip, a row's hover fill, a 40px lead tile.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The default: buttons, fields, select triggers, menus' rows container.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Same as radius; the Tailwind preset's md key.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Confirmed. A raised group and a standard card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Confirmed. A large card: a record's summary, a web popover.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The ceiling: sheets, dialogs, the docked panel, the Ask answer card. Nothing rounder except a switch track, a meter and the phone's glass chrome.

shadow.note: Shadows are banned (foundations §10). Elevation is a lighter surface step plus the hairline. The tokens exist only to neutralise leftover shadow utilities.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Banned: use the surface ladder.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Banned: use the surface ladder.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Banned: use the surface ladder.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Banned: use the surface ladder.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Banned: use the surface ladder.

duration.note: From packages/theme/src/motion.ts and signature.ts. The four classes are Confirmed (rulebook §7); the numbers are provisional in foundations §11.

tokens.name: duration-micro
tokens.usage: Confirmed class, provisional number. Micro-feedback: a press, a hover, a switch, a checkbox.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Confirmed class, provisional number. A standard transition: a menu or popover opening, a row sliding apart while reordering.

tokens.name: duration-context
tokens.usage: Confirmed class, provisional number. A context shift: a panel docking, a sheet rising, a pushed screen.

tokens.name: duration-signature
tokens.usage: Confirmed class (Paul 2026-11-06, #3493). One piece of a signature moment, on easing-settle. Only moments in the catalog use it.

tokens.name: duration-signature-total
tokens.usage: Confirmed (signature.ts totalMs). The whole of a signature moment, first frame to rest. It plays once and never loops.

tokens.name: duration-signature-stagger
tokens.usage: Confirmed (signature.ts staggerMs). Between one item landing and the next; at most 8 items land in turn.

tokens.name: duration-skeleton-sweep
tokens.usage: Confirmed (signet.css .skeleton-shimmer). One linear pass of the skeleton shimmer across a 260px tile.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Confirmed (motion.ts). Default curve for anything that moves and stays.

tokens.name: easing-entrance
tokens.usage: Confirmed (motion.ts). Something arriving: a menu, a sheet, a toast.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Confirmed (motion.ts). Something leaving.

tokens.name: easing-settle
tokens.usage: Confirmed (motion.ts). Overshoots a little and comes back. Only a signature moment's landing.

glass.note: From packages/theme/src/glass.ts (Paul 2026-11-05, "Floating bar, no glow"). Glass is chrome only: the phone's tab bar, back capsule, floating create button and action bar, its menus, and the blur under a scrim. Never a sheet, a card or a field.

tokens.name: glass-fill-alpha
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Alpha of surface-1 over the blur.

tokens.name: glass-fill-alpha-unblurred
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Alpha of surface-1 where nothing blurs behind (Android today), so a label never sits on raw content.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Backdrop blur radius.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Confirmed. The 1px edge of a glass shape.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: Confirmed. White at the top of the sheen, fading out by glass-specular-stop.

tokens.name: glass-specular-stop
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Where the sheen has faded to nothing.

tokens.name: glass-scrim-blur
tokens.usage: Confirmed. Blur under a dialog or sheet scrim, beneath 55% black.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §10). Spread of the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring-opacity
tokens.usage: Confirmed (foundations §10). Opacity of ring in the focus spread. The control's border switches to accent-text at the same time, and that border, not the spread, is what clears 3:1.
